subject: A sugar-free brand with no {{country_name}} partner yet
body:
Europe's largest sugar-free confectionery company, looking for a partner in {{market_country}}
Hi {{full_name}},

I'm writing from the office of the Strategy Director at Diablo Sugar Free, where I look after international partners.

I thought I'd reach out as we noticed {{companyName}} {{company_note}}. We are a UK brand without a direct partner in {{market_country}} yet, and given your reach, we believe we could grow well together.

{{bond_paragraph}}By way of introduction, we are Europe's largest sugar-free confectionery company, with 117 products across 11 categories, from cakes and biscuits to wafers and spreads.

As you'll know, sugar-free carries a better margin than standard confectionery, as the shopper accepts a higher price point. We supply more than 126 countries and are listed with Carrefour, Tesco, Lidl and Holland & Barrett.

Here is the link to our catalogue for your information: {{catalogue_link_text}}

I'd love to set up a call with your team and our Strategy Director to look at what the range would need to earn properly for your professional customers.

Would this week work, or would next week be better suited?

Book a quick meeting with us: {{booking_link_text}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
International Account Executive
Diablo Sugar Free


We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.
